entry_requirements: There is no formal academic entry requirement. To join and benefit fully, a learner needs
A smartphone or laptop (either is enough; both is ideal). Academy computers are available for anyone with neither
Basic ability to use that device — opening an app, typing, taking a photo, browsing. Assumed, not taught
A free email account (Gmail preferred) to create the free tool accounts
A working microphone and speakers/earphones — the ones bundled with the device are fine
Willingness to be recorded during practice, or to direct a classmate off-camera instead
Something to teach. Every learner needs a real or fictional subject they genuinely know
Willingness to follow the rules in Section 15 without exception
Not required no laptop; no prior teaching qualification or classroom experience; no prior knowledge of Zoom, Classroom, Canva or OBS (all
problem: Online Teaching is a practical, beginner-level short course that turns a person who talks to a class into a person who can design, build and deliver a small course on the internet — using only a phone or laptop and free tools. It is built around doing, not listening. From the first session, learners choose a teaching mode, write outcomes, build slides, record short video lessons, run a live class on Zoom or Google Meet, and build a quiz in Google Forms. The course hangs on one honest promise: If you can teach it in a room, you can learn to teach it online — and you do not need to pay for a single subscription to do it.
